privatePriceDrop.question: Does the price of a private company drop by 5 for no sale in the first round?
privatePriceDrop.answer: No, but any starting package certificates unsold after the first round are offered for sale in the next SR. If nobody wants the offered certificate, its price is reduced by 10 until the offered price is 50% (rounded up) of the initial price. If nobody wants it at that price, the player offering it has to buy it, or if they do not have enough cash, the player to their right. This procedure is repeated for the remaining starting package certificates.

forcedTrainAfford.question: When a company is forced to buy a train and cannot buy one with its own means, what train may it then buy?
forcedTrainAfford.answer: The cheapest new train from the bank, or any train from the bank pool.

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: The game offers a number of variants: Optional 2 train - one additional 2 train to gurantee at least two yellow ORs Delayed Exchange in Merger Industrial Areas - 5 Industry markers, one for each company Grey Phase - 4 additional tiles for Koln and one other grey tile Existing Track - 2 tiles that start in play and 2 additional tiles to make the northern     part of the board more interesting
